summary: Frontend-only testing completed for Le Court Central tennis app. All 3 bugs and 3 features tested and verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug #1: Add observation button (testID='add-observation-btn') works correctly - opens observation modal from event detail
Bug #2: Calendar remains fully functional after event modification - state management is correct with immutable updates
Bug #3: Upload modal opens correctly with camera and gallery options (data-testid='fab-upload', 'upload-camera', 'upload-gallery')
Feature #1: TOURNAMENT_STATUS_LABELS correctly defines 'Intéressé' label for 'interested' status (line 59-65 in index.tsx)
Feature #2: Week cards show 'X tournois' badge when hasMultipleTournaments (lines 879-887 in index.tsx)
Feature #3: Auto-graying implemented in executeRegistration function (lines 559-624) - sets other tournaments to 'not_interested' when participating

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All 3 bugs fixed, all 3 features working

seed_data_creation: Used existing seed data: Events on Feb 15 (3 events) and Feb 18 (2 events), Tournament weeks S8-S34
context_for_next_testing_agent: All bugs and features verified working. App is React Native Expo - web preview accessible via /(tabs) route. Calendar screen shows events and tournament weeks. Documents/Vault screen accessible via /(tabs)/vault.

Bug #1 - Add Observation Button.details: Click + button on event detail modal opens observation modal correctly. Button at coordinates (1878, 551) with green add-circle icon.

Bug #2 - Calendar After Event Modificati.details: After modifying event (06:30 Préparation Physique on Feb 15), calendar remains fully functional. Can click other days (tested Feb 18), navigate months, and open other events.

Bug #3 - Upload Modal Camera/Gallery.details: FAB camera button at (1870, 906) opens upload modal with 'Ajouter un reçu' title, 'Prendre une photo' (camera) and 'Galerie photos' (gallery) options.

Feature #1 - Intéressé Label.details: Tournament status badge correctly shows 'Intéressé' (not 'Participant') when status is 'interested'. Verified on week S9 Dubai Duty Free Tennis.

Feature #2 - X tournois Badge.details: Week cards show 'X tournois' badge when multiple tournaments in same week. Week S8 shows 3 tournaments (Qatar, Rio, Delray Beach), Week S9 shows 3 tournaments (Dubai, Acapulco, Santiago).

Feature #3 - Auto-Graying Tournaments.details: When participating in Qatar ExxonMobil Open (S8), Rio Open and Delray Beach Open are automatically grayed out with 'Rétablir' (Restore) button. Conflict detection dialog also shown before registration.
